newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti sells sells stake in Synthesis.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti sells sells stake in Synthesis.

text.p: Italian information technology group Olivetti said on Wednesday it had sold its whole stake in office equipment company Olivetti Synthesis to a group of entrepreneurs.
Olivetti said in a statement the buyers would manage the business through Siccma Spa.

It said the effect of the sale on Olivetti's balance sheet and profits and liabilities was practically neutral and provisions had already been made in 1996 results for the capital loss of 12 billion lire.

The office equipment company will be called Synthesis in future but can use the Olivetti Synthesis marque up to the year 2002. Turnover in 1996 was 66 billion and employees at the end of March 1997 totalled 280.
